en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a rural railway station area. In the left foreground stands a large multi‑storey wooden building with steep gabled roofs and decorative trim, overlooking a trackside scene below. A fence and small yard lead toward the station area. In the mid‑distance along the right side run railway tracks with a train and several smaller station buildings beside a fjord or lake, surrounded by forested hills. At the top of the image is a printed caption reading "Parti ved Veldre St."
